messages:
acme_infra: Hey @maria_support — embeddings endpoint returning 400/422 intermittently. Sending from frontend using fetch and JSON.stringify. Error: "InvalidEmbeddingSize: expected 1536 got 2". Any pointers?

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact request body + headers (redact keys) and which model you're calling?

acme_infra: here's curl (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer [REDACTED]" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"[0.12,0.34]"}'
```
Response:
```json
{ "error": { "message": "InvalidEmbeddingSize: expected 1536 got 2" } }
```

sam_eng: The payload is the problem — you sent the vector as a string ("[0.12,0.34]"). That means the server sees a single string scalar instead of a numeric array. Also note embed-large expects a 1536-dim vector; 2 != 1536. Two quick options: send an actual numeric array for a precomputed embedding, or send text (string) so the model computes the vector.

sam_eng: Corrected curl examples:
```bash
# precomputed vector (example truncated)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":[0.12,0.34,0.01, ... ,0.02]}'
```
or if you want the model to embed text:
```bash
-d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"hello world"}'
```

sam_eng: If you're sending multiple items in one request, pass an array of items: "input": ["one","two"] for text batching, or "input": [[v1...],[v2...]] for multiple precomputed vectors.

ingrid_se: Also watch for double JSON.stringify on the client. Bad pattern we see often: 
```js
// BAD — vector becomes a quoted string inside JSON
const body = JSON.stringify({ model: 'embed-large', input: JSON.stringify(vector) })
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body })
```
Should be:
```js
// GOOD
const body = JSON.stringify({ model: 'embed-large', input: vector })
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body })
```
Also confirm you set Content-Type header; some frameworks default to text/plain when body is already a string.

acme_infra: omg — we are doing JSON.stringify(vector) inside. Re-testing now.

ops-bot: Rate limit notice — 429 returned 2x in the last minute for user=acme_infra (bursting due to retries).

maria_support: If you still see 400 after removing the extra stringify, paste a full sample and we'll repro. Also check the model->dim mapping in docs (embed-small=384, embed-large=1536). If you meant to upload precomputed 1536-dim vectors, confirm your vector source/transform doesn't truncate.

acme_infra: Fixed — client now sends numeric array and errors are gone. We did see a brief 429 while we retried; throttling smoothed after backoff. Thanks for the quick help :tada:

maria_support: Glad that fixed it. I'll close the ticket in 24h if we don't hear back.
